rationale: Identity was properly verified via name and zip. The agent looked up the order and product options correctly. However, the agent performed an order-changing write (exchanging both the water bottle and the lamp) without first explicitly stating the exact changes and obtaining the user's confirmation, which violates the policy. Additionally, per the user's subsequent request to proceed only with the lamp exchange, the agent asserted that the exchange could not be changed or canceled without any tool-based confirmation, making an unsupported claim instead of checking options or offering a handoff. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
